instruction:
Software launch locations: LibreCAD: `/usr/bin/librecad`; FreeCAD: `/usr/bin/freecad`; KiCad: `/home/user/Applications/kicad-10.0.2/kicad-10.0.2-x86_64.AppImage`; Blender: `/home/user/Applications/blender-4.2.3-linux-x64/blender`. Required four-software transfer workflow: LibreCAD -> FreeCAD -> KiCad -> Blender. Start from the provided seed DXF /home/user/Desktop/seed_round_gauge_bezel.dxf; do not start from a blank or unrelated drawing. This is a chained workflow: every later stage must read an artifact from the previous stage, and every required intermediate file must be saved on the Desktop. The design token for this task is EW4G04; keep this token visible in the DXF labels and KiCad silkscreen. The Blender output must visibly consume the stage-2 STL and stage-3 SVG through Blender's native import/export operations.

Design goal: Round instrument gauge bezel with OLED and encoder board. This case is intentionally different from the other benchmark cases: domain=instrument_display_bezel, mechanical target=an instrument front view with smoky display lens and a raised encoder knob, electronics target=a circular gauge PCB carrying an OLED display, encoder, buzzer, mode button, and I2C header.

1. LibreCAD stage: open the provided seed file /home/user/Desktop/seed_round_gauge_bezel.dxf in LibreCAD, use it as the starting drawing, complete the required 2D geometry, remove all GUIDE construction entities, and save /home/user/Desktop/stage1_round_gauge_bezel.dxf. Use millimeters. Use layers OUTLINE, WINDOW, HOLE, LABEL. The overall drawing envelope must be 118 mm x 118 mm. Include the required circular features: center (59,59) radius 59; center (59,59) radius 34; center (59,12) radius 2.1; center (106,59) radius 2.1; center (59,106) radius 2.1; center (12,59) radius 2.1. Add readable labels EW4G04, OLED, ENCODER, BEZEL on the LABEL layer.
2. FreeCAD stage: import /home/user/Desktop/stage1_round_gauge_bezel.dxf in FreeCAD. Create the 3D mechanical body from that LibreCAD DXF with a localized substantial raised encoder-control region above the base and bezel heights, and export the body as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_round_gauge_bezel.stl with an approximate bounding size of 118 mm x 118 mm x 18 mm. Then, from the same FreeCAD model, export a top-face or board-interface outline for KiCad as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_round_gauge_bezel_handoff_outline.dxf. This handoff DXF must contain the circular board outline and all four stage-1 mounting holes, represent the same XY envelope as the FreeCAD body, and export the visible labels FREECAD_TO_KICAD and EW4G04 as two FreeCAD ShapeString outline objects.
3. KiCad stage: open KiCad and use /home/user/Desktop/stage2_round_gauge_bezel_handoff_outline.dxf as the geometric source for one matching circular Edge.Cuts outline centered at (59,59) with radius 59; importing the DXF or accurately recreating that circle are equivalent. Save /home/user/Desktop/stage3_round_gauge_bezel_board.kicad_pcb. Add five native footprints: DS1 as a four-pad OLED display, SW1 as a five-pad rotary encoder, BZ1 as a two-pad buzzer, SW2 as a two-pad mode button, and J1 as a four-pad I2C header. Add F.SilkS text carrying KICAD_TO_BLENDER, EDGE_FROM_STAGE2_HANDOFF, the stage2 handoff filename, EW4G04, OLED-DS1, ENCODER-SW1, BUZZER-BZ1, BTN-MODE, and I2C-J1. Then use KiCad's plot/export workflow to create /home/user/Desktop/stage3_round_gauge_bezel_board_profile.svg from the same circular Edge.Cuts outline.
4. Blender stage: open Blender. Import /home/user/Desktop/stage2_round_gauge_bezel.stl with Blender's STL importer, then import /home/user/Desktop/stage3_round_gauge_bezel_board_profile.svg with Blender's SVG importer. Correct the SVG import scale so the visible circular profile matches the full 118 mm diameter carrier. Keep the imported STL body and SVG-derived profile geometry in the scene. Make the instrument front visibly contain a dark translucent smoky OLED lens across the center window and a distinct raised encoder knob. Export glTF Binary (.glb) as /home/user/Desktop/stage4_round_gauge_bezel.glb. Do not satisfy these requirements with names or manually injected metadata alone.

Required deliverables on the Desktop: /home/user/Desktop/stage1_round_gauge_bezel.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_round_gauge_bezel.stl, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_round_gauge_bezel_handoff_outline.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_round_gauge_bezel_board.kicad_pcb, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_round_gauge_bezel_board_profile.svg, /home/user/Desktop/stage4_round_gauge_bezel.glb.

[Software] Use LibreCAD first, then FreeCAD, then KiCad, then Blender. Do not skip stages, reorder stages, or recreate the final result in only one software package.
